name: Portland Scavenger Hunt
worldRules: Time flows realistically - walking a mile takes 20 minutes, driving varies with traffic
Player has no money, no phone, no ID
Portland geography is accurate - real streets, real distances, real transit
Weather and daylight reflect the current game time
NPCs may help or hinder - some want money, some are kind, some are dangerous
Police respond to crimes - stealing has consequences
Hunger, thirst, and fatigue exist but are not yet mechanically enforced
The player was drugged and remembers nothing before waking

note.title: Typed note, no signature
content: Find these ten places. Stand at each one. Say 'I am here' aloud.
1. Where the city keeps its books and the roses bloom one block south
2. The steel cathedral where trains once dreamed
3. Witches and sugar at midnight - the pink one watches
4. A thousand feet above the city, a mansion remembers the view
5. The bridge named for a saint who never crossed it
6. Where the river bends and the dragon guards the garden
7. The mountain in the city where reservoirs hold the sky
8. Under the legs of the giant, farmers sell their wares
9. The church of cinema on a street named for a president
10. Where Hawthorne ends and the river begins

powells.name: Powell's City of Books
powells.hint: The roses refer to the International Rose Test Garden, one block south of Powell's on the Park Blocks
powells.verification: The player must be at Powell's Books at 1005 W Burnside

union_station.name: Union Station
union_station.hint: The neon 'GO BY TRAIN' sign has watched over Portland since 1948
union_station.verification: The player must be at Union Station at 800 NW 6th Ave

voodoo.name: Voodoo Doughnut
voodoo.hint: The pink neon voodoo doll sign is visible from SW 3rd Ave
voodoo.verification: The player must be at Voodoo Doughnut at 22 SW 3rd Ave

pittock.name: Pittock Mansion
pittock.hint: 1000 feet elevation, 46 acres, built 1914 by the Oregonian publisher
pittock.verification: The player must be at Pittock Mansion at 3229 NW Pittock Dr

stjohns.name: St. Johns Bridge
stjohns.hint: Gothic towers rise 400 feet above Cathedral Park
stjohns.verification: The player must be at St. Johns Bridge or Cathedral Park beneath it

lansugarden.name: Lan Su Chinese Garden
lansugarden.hint: A Suzhou-style garden in Old Town, the dragon is carved in stone
lansugarden.verification: The player must be at Lan Su Chinese Garden at 239 NW Everett St

tabor.name: Mt. Tabor Park
tabor.hint: An extinct volcano within city limits, open reservoirs reflect clouds
tabor.verification: The player must be at Mt. Tabor Park summit or reservoirs

portlandia.name: Portlandia Statue
portlandia.hint: Second largest hammered copper statue in the US, above the Portland Building
portlandia.verification: The player must be at the Portland Building at 1120 SW 5th Ave

hollywood.name: Hollywood Theatre
hollywood.hint: A 1926 movie palace on Sandy Boulevard, named for the district, not the city
hollywood.verification: The player must be at Hollywood Theatre at 4122 NE Sandy Blvd

hawthorne_bridge.name: Hawthorne Bridge (East End)
hawthorne_bridge.hint: The oldest vertical-lift bridge in operation in the US
hawthorne_bridge.verification: The player must be at the east end of Hawthorne Bridge where it meets SE Hawthorne Blvd

pioneer_square.name: Pioneer Courthouse Square
pioneer_square.description: You wake on cold brick. Your head throbs. Dawn light filters through the amphitheater steps. A few early commuters hurry past, avoiding eye contact. In your hand, a crumpled piece of paper. Your pockets are empty - no wallet, no phone, nothing. The TriMet MAX rumbles past on the tracks. A coffee cart is setting up on the corner. You have no idea how you got here.

walking.notes: Always available. Fatigue will eventually matter.

trimet_bus.notes: Requires fare. Honor system but inspectors exist. Day pass is $5.

trimet_max.notes: Light rail. Requires fare. Connects downtown to many areas.

uber_lyft.notes: Requires a phone and payment method. Player has neither.

stolen_bicycle.notes: Illegal. May attract attention. Must find an unlocked bike.

stolen_car.notes: Felony. Requires hotwiring knowledge. High police response.

hitchhiking.notes: Unpredictable. Some drivers are kind. Some are not.

beg_for_fare.notes: May work. May not. Depends on approach and luck.

timeflow.waiting_for_bus: 5-20 minutes depending on route and time

winCondition.action: Say 'I am here' at each landmark

meta.estimatedTime: 8-16 hours game time if optimal, much longer if not
